judgement.doubts: All events are bounds on H1; the bullet (infinitely many twin primes) stays open, so progress is the ceiling. The status rests on the 186 bound, which supersedes 240/236/212 on the same quantity; it is unreviewed and its formal proof is conditional on axioms, so if it failed the row would fall back to Axiom's 212 (ai_role none, formalisation only) or Stadlmann's 240 (none). Record's early 'ai_role bound' rationale is obsolete; the 2026-09-24 correction to generated is right. The 212/186 ordering is unclear but irrelevant since 186 is the stronger bound. Unvetted 2025 full-proof preprints were rightly not counted.

corrections.why: F10: kept, but the event it rests on (GPT-6 Astra's H1 <= 186) has no independent human reading and its Lean formalisation is 'conditional on three unproven Lean axioms'; if it fails, the furthest surviving bound is Axiom's 212, whose AI contribution is formalisation only (none).
